summary: Read-only check of the Rakhigarhi 'The Ambition' spacing (#the-ambition) on the public preview at 1920, 1440, 1280 and 390px, plus a test of the live editor's Whole-section Height and Space-bottom/Padding-bottom controls without saving. Nothing was saved, and the public API content hash for rakhigarhi was the same before and after (md5 d8de3b4e437949435102cb1897d18578). Result: the extra space comes from a hardcoded padding-bottom on the inner section, and the editor cannot reduce it. Space bottom only adds space on top of it, and Height does nothing because a stylesheet rule overrides it.

measurements.desktop_1920: Grey panel = wrapper div.hb.hb-text#the-ambition, 1339px wide, x 290 to 1630, height 782. The wrapper has 0 padding. Inner section.wrap.section.stacked (data-testid block-8) has padding 150px top / 180px bottom and 80px left/right. The content div ends at 4236 and the panel at 4416, so 180px of blank space sits under the last line of text. Footer starts at 4416 (gap 0) and has the same edges (x 290 to 1630, width 1339).
measurements.desktop_1440: Panel x 50 to 1390, footer x 50 to 1390, inner padding-bottom 180px, footer gap 0.
measurements.desktop_1280: Panel x 45 to 1235, footer x 45 to 1235. Inner padding is still 150/180px because the 100px rule only applies at 1200px and below.
measurements.mobile_390: Panel x 24 to 366, footer x 24 to 366, inner padding 64/64px, footer gap 0.
measurements.note: In the preview, edges match and there is no gap before the footer, so the visible blank area is entirely the inner section's 180px bottom padding (plus the 150px top padding). Saved editor styles on the user's live site could change this (see rca).

winning_rules: Bottom space: rakhigarhi-reference.css line 69 `.site #rakhigarhi-reference #the-ambition .stacked { padding-block: 150px 180px !important }`. It overrides `.site #rakhigarhi-reference .section {padding-block:88px !important}` and `.site:has(main) main .section {padding-block:var(--sec-y) !important}`. Media overrides: 100px at 1200px and below (line ~90), 64px on mobile (line ~127).

Height: boxed-layout.css line 239 `html body #public-site#public-site main :is(...,#the-ambition,...) { height:auto !important; min-height:0 !important }`, specificity 3 ids. It beats index.css lines 1653/1658 `body.live-editing #public-site [style*="--ed-h"] { height: var(--ed-h) !important }`, specificity 1 id + 2 classes/attrs. Both are !important, so the higher specificity wins and Height is ignored.

Width/edges: boxed-layout.css lines 11-18 give the wrapper `width:var(--box-w) !important; margin-left:calc(50% - var(--box-w)/2) !important; overflow:hidden`, but only when the wrapper has no `--ed-w` in its inline style.

ui_bugs.component: LiveEditor Whole section > Height / resize handles
ui_bugs.issue: No effect on #the-ambition, and probably on every wrapper in the boxed list (.hb.band, .hb.hb-bg, #archaeology, #active-use-summary, #restoration-skills). boxed-layout.css:239 `height:auto !important` (3-id selector) overrides the `[style*=--ed-h]` height rule. applyProps sets only the --ed-h variable, never `height` itself, so the inline value cannot win.

ui_bugs.component: LiveEditor Whole section > Space bottom / Padding bottom
ui_bugs.issue: Only adds space. The real space is the inner `section.stacked` padding-bottom of 180px !important (rakhigarhi-reference.css:69), which the editor never targets, so users cannot reduce the blank area. The placeholder shows 0, which is misleading.
180px of blank space under the last text on desktop (above 1200px) plus 150px on top. The 961-1200px range uses 100px and mobile uses 64px.

issues: Bottom padding (180px) is larger than top (150px), so the panel looks bottom-heavy before the footer

action_items: Make section spacing editable. Option (a): move the default spacing to a CSS variable, e.g. `#the-ambition .stacked { padding-block: var(--sec-pt,150px) var(--sec-pb,180px) !important }`, and have the _section paddingTop/paddingBottom set --sec-pt/--sec-pb on the wrapper. Option (b): in Block's ref, apply _section padding to the inner `:scope > section` and zero the wrapper. Either way, the field placeholder should show the inner section's computed padding, not the wrapper's 0.

Make Whole-section Height work: exclude edited wrappers from the auto-height rule, e.g. `:is(...):not([style*="--ed-h"]) { height:auto !important; min-height:0 !important }` in boxed-layout.css:239, or add `[style*="--ed-h"]` with equal or higher specificity. Consider using min-height (not height) for sections so text is never clipped. Note the boxed rule's overflow:hidden is replaced inline by overflow:visible, so a smaller height lets text spill out over the footer.
Reduce the default bottom padding, e.g. 180px to 120px, to match the reference if needed.

On the live site, check for saved `styles._section` on the ambition section (width/marginLeft/paddingBottom). A saved `--ed-w` drops the wrapper out of the boxed-width rule (`:not([style*="--ed-w"])`), and saved margins are applied inline with !important. Either would make the grey panel's edges stop matching the footer even though the preview matches.
critical_code_review_comments: Blocks.jsx Block(): applyProps writes _section styles onto the outer wrapper, but the page CSS puts its spacing on the inner section, so editor padding and the stylesheet padding stack instead of replacing each other.
layoutStyle() for _section sets `place-self:flex-start start` and `position:relative` on the wrapper whenever height is set. This is harmless in block flow but adds noise.
LiveEditor.jsx padPH() reads the selected element's (wrapper's) computed padding, so it shows 0 while 180px sits on the child.
LiveEditor.jsx is 726 lines, over the 700-line guideline.

success_rate.frontend: Diagnosis only: section Height control 0% effective, Space bottom only increases spacing

rca of the issue: Excess space: the hardcoded 150/180px !important padding-block on the inner .stacked section (rakhigarhi-reference.css:69). Section not resizable: the editor writes _section styles to the outer wrapper. Padding there adds to the inner padding instead of replacing it. Height is set only as the --ed-h variable, and the [style*=--ed-h] height rule loses to boxed-layout.css:239 `height:auto !important` (3-id selector). Reproduce: open the editor, select The Ambition whole section, set Height 500: computed height stays 782. Set Space bottom 0: blank area stays 180px. Set Space bottom 20: blank area becomes 200px.
